title: 第2702章 融合第2701章 千古图谋
slug: 我修天道见谁都能一招秒
content_zh:
被钉在血肉之门上的人，正是第十二道神，云霄无上。
此刻云霄无上的丹田气海处，同样多了数个血洞。
他身上还有残存的大道之力气息残留，显然也是被生生挖出了大道道果，整个陷入昏厥之中。
“你们两个，竟然选择他？”
前任混乱天雾主人见到这一幕，眼中充斥着悲愤之色。
那种感觉，就仿佛自己遭遇了背叛一般。
青铜仙殿之中，一道淡漠的声音幽幽响起，道：“你背弃了半大人。”
“我没有！
我要见半大人，我才是更好的逆天之子人选！”
前任混乱天雾主人近乎嘶哑喊道。
就在这时，血肉之门之中，一道嘶哑邪意的声音传来，道：“半大人不想见你！
我说老友，我劝你还是安心上路吧，这样我们也都能轻松一些！”
随着声音响起，青铜仙殿四周，道道雷霆凝聚。
而血肉之门之中，也有血气逸散而出。
前任混乱天雾主人见状，瞳孔一缩，转身就想离开。
可谁知，就在这时……
轰隆隆！
接引之门方向，又是一阵扭曲。
紧跟着，那里空间扭曲，而后两尊巨大的神像，出现在众人眼前。
轰！

与此同时，两尊神像身上，爆发出了强大的威压，直接将前任混乱天雾主人锁定。
“什么？连你也……”
而在看到这两尊神像之后，前任混乱天雾主人的身子顿时僵在了当场。
他的眼中，充斥了绝望，一时间都忘记了逃走。
而在这时，元灵不灭城城主开口道：“好了，几位，不要再耽误时间了！
半大人已经等不及了！”
血肉之门内，传来一阵诡异笑声，道：“好！”
轰！
下一瞬，血肉之门洞开，一只沾染了腐肉的白骨巨爪，从其中探了出来。
轰隆隆！
另一边，青铜仙殿上空，一道虚淡的剑影浮现而出，而后无尽雷霆汹涌而下。
见到这一幕，前任混乱天雾主人终于回过神来。
就见他双眼之中，闪过意丝狠厉，目光扫过众人，道：“既然你们要我死，那我要让你们什么都得不到！”
轰！
他说着，一掌拍在自己气海之上。
一瞬间，他气海倒转，所有的仙气、威压全都膨胀起来，身上的威压急速攀升。
content_en:
The person nailed to the door of flesh and blood is the twelfth god, supreme in the sky.
At this moment, there are also several blood holes in the dantian qi sea that is the highest in the sky.
He still had the remaining aura of the power of the Great Dao on his body, and it was obvious that the Dao Dao Fruit had been dug out of him, and he fell into a coma.
"You two actually chose him?"
When the former master of Chaos Tianwu saw this scene, his eyes were full of grief and anger.
It felt like he had been betrayed.
In the Bronze Immortal Palace, an indifferent voice sounded faintly, saying: "You have betrayed half an adult."
"I didn't!
I want to meet a semi-adult, I am a better candidate for the Son of Heaven! "
The former master of Chaos Tianwu shouted almost hoarsely.
At this moment, a hoarse and evil voice came from the Gate of Flesh and Flesh, saying: "I don't want to see you!
I said, old friend, I advise you to go on the road with peace of mind, so that we can all feel more relaxed! "
As the sound rang out, thunder gathered around the Bronze Immortal Palace.
And from the door of flesh and blood, blood energy also escapes.
Seeing this, the former master of Chaos Tianwu shrank his pupils, turned around and wanted to leave.
But who knows, at this moment...
Boom!
There was another distortion in the direction of the Leading Gate.
Immediately afterwards, the space there was distorted, and then two huge statues appeared in front of everyone.
boom!
At the same time, powerful pressure erupted from the two statues, directly locking the former master of Chaos Tianwu.
"What? Even you..."
After seeing these two statues, the former master of Chaos Tianwu froze on the spot.
His eyes were filled with despair, and he forgot to escape for a moment.
At this moment, the Lord of Yuanling Immortal City said: "Okay, everyone, don't waste any more time!
The half-grown man can't wait! "
Inside the door of flesh and blood, there was a strange laughter, saying: "Okay!"
Boom!
The next moment, the door of flesh and blood opened, and a giant claw of white bones stained with rotten flesh poked out from it.
Boom!
On the other side, in the sky above the Bronze Immortal Palace, a faint sword shadow emerged, and then endless thunder surged down.
Seeing this scene, the former master of Chaos Tianwu finally came to his senses.
I saw a fierce look flashing in his eyes, and he glanced at everyone and said: "Since you want me to die, then I will make sure that you get nothing!"
Boom!
He said, slapping his palm on top of his Qi Sea.
In an instant, his Qi sea reversed, all the immortal energy and pressure swelled up, and the pressure on his body rose rapidly.
